thesis: This episode argues that Vanguard represents a unique, shareholder-funded business model that has achieved superior long-term performance (84% outperformance) and significantly reduced expense ratios (0.07%) compared to peers. It contrasts this with traditional active management firms like Wellington and Berkshire, highlighting the structural advantages of Vanguard's approach while noting that even Berkshire's massive asset base is effectively a private equity firm owned by Warren Buffett.
